title: 3-Hour Beyond the Bridge Buggy Tour to Sausalito
includes: 8.75% environmental fee for carbon offset, gas and tire recycling
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take an Epic San Francisco Electric Car Tour to the Golden Gate Bridge, Sausalito & Beyond
Hop into GoCAR’s EV Sport and explore San Francisco’s hidden gems on a GPS-guided electric vehicle tour. Cruise through the Presidio and Crissy Field en route to the Golden Gate Bridge, then head across to the scenic waterfront town of Sausalito. Capture amazing photos of the Pacific Ocean and the bridge up close—with the option to park and walk across it. Extend your adventure with a detour into the historic Marin Headlands, featuring epic coastal roads built by the U.S. Army. Wrap up your San Francisco tour with an exciting climb up Russian Hill and an optional drive down the iconic Lombard Street, where tour buses can’t go.
